_about: CEO 29.10 (trips abroad, wave 1, server only): the car border crossings the engine routes through, from docs/plan/abroad-wave1-sources.md (search results of 2026-10-29, «не проверено»).

No source gave a crossing's coordinates (sources doc §11 item 4). `anchor` names the nearest catalogue town on the `country` side: the stop is put there and says so (`coordsApprox`). A crossing without an anchor is put where the straight line between the two waypoints leaves the first country, snapped to the nearest catalogue town on that side.
`between`: the two countries; the engine finds a path of crossings between any two supported countries (Russia — Georgia — Turkey …). `marker`: a border without a checkpoint (no dwell).
`wait`: only what a source says about the wait; null = «время ожидания неизвестно» and the planner's buffer (planner_config.json `border.buffer_min`), labelled as a buffer.
